processed_data.covariance_convention: Only after passing the precision check, use (C+C.T)/2 and report original asymmetry; preserve exact raw text.

class_contrast.definition: equal arithmetic high mean minus equal arithmetic low mean relative to q=.5 distance

processed_data.scope: Exposed processed-summary comparison. No raw-photometry refit, global blind test, independent reuse of overlapping diagnostics, or luminosity-evolution claim.
